name: What kind of maintenance is required for a custom patio cover?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for a custom patio cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The maintenance required for a custom patio cover depends heavily on the materials chosen during the design phase. For instance, an aluminum patio cover typically requires less maintenance than a wood structure, which may need periodic sealing or painting to protect against weather elements. Regardless of material, routine cleaning to remove debris and check for any minor wear is generally recommended to preserve its appearance and structural integrity. AKN Design Group provides guidance on material selection and long-term care, helping you choose options that align with your desired maintenance level while maintaining durability and craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance for a custom patio cover varies by material, with aluminum requiring less than wood. Routine cleaning and checks are generally recommended to preserve its integrity.
